game.name: Frontier Hunter: Erza's Wheel of Fortune

items.text: After defeating the final BOSS, preparations for the return to the hometown are proceeding smoothly. At this moment, a mysterious character visits Erza's team, warning of signs of the Heaven’s Punishment event, while the wheel of fate for the Demon King is swaying violently…

notes.title: The new version has adjusted the following content

items.text: 1. In the BOSS challenge room, the final BOSS challenge is now open. Players will be able to challenge the final BOSS in its ultimate transformation stage.
2. Adjusted the mana consumption and healing amount of the magical device "Tranquil Dew." Mana consumption is fixed at 350 and can be used in all stages of challenge mode.
3. Fixed the issue where the Sunflame Leg skill would still activate in the air after being turned off.
4. Fixed the issue where some monsters couldn't be hit after jumping.
5. Added missing barriers in some scenes.
6. Adjusted the positions of certain mechanisms to make them easier to recognize.
7. Adjusted some action modules after the protagonist lands from being hit, allowing the stance to recover quickly upon landing.
Free Major Update: “Legacy of the Demon King”

Includes 8 new hidden areas in scenes such as the Glow Forest ~ Mysterious Cave, Desert Prison ~ City of the Ghouls; Added over 20 powerful new monsters and corresponding magic cores; Erza will inherit Eva's weapon; Super powerful new weapons, armor, and accessories will push the protagonist's team to break all limits; The rumored hidden BOSS will also make an appearance! Defeating the hidden BOSS will reward you with a new swimsuit for free! Additionally, there are some storyline completions that won't be detailed here to avoid spoilers.
Final DLC: Mother's Trial After purchasing this DLC

players will be able to fight Erza’s mother after clearing the game. The battle takes place in the virtual training room of the airship, where Erza's mother will test her daughter and disciple to see how much they’ve grown. This challenge can be repeated.
This DLC will be the last DLC for our entire game.

After this major update and DLC, we won’t have any more large updates in the future, but we will continue to fix clear bugs. From now on, we will be fully committed to our new project and bring you even better works.
Sincerely,
Icesitruuna

releases.displayName: Update Preview - Legacy of the Diablo、 Mother's Trial

items.text: After defeating the final boss, preparations for returning home are progressing smoothly. At this moment, a mysterious character visited Erza's team and warned that signs of the "Divine Punishment" event have emerged. Meanwhile, the wheel of the Demon King's fate is spinning wildly...
Free Major Update: "Legacy of the Demon King"
Includes new hidden areas in 8 scenes such as Glowing ForestMysterious Cave, Desert PrisonCity of Ghouls;
Over 20 powerful monsters and their corresponding magic cores will be added;
Elsa will inherit Eva's weapon;
Extremely powerful new weapons, armor, and accessories will push the main team beyond their limits;
The rumored hidden boss will also make an appearance! Defeating the hidden boss will reward you with a new swimsuit for free!
Some story enhancements are also included, but details are omitted to avoid spoilers.
Final DLC: "Mother's Trial"

After purchasing this DLC, players will be able to battle Elsa's mother after completing the game. The battle will take place in the virtual training room of the airship, where Elsa's mother will test how far her daughter and disciple have grown. This challenge can be repeated multiple times.
This DLC will be the final DLC for the entire game.

After the completion of this major update and DLC, there will be no further large updates, but we will continue to fix any confirmed bugs. Moving forward, we will be fully devoted to a new project, bringing even better works to everyone.
The date for the major update is September 12, 2024. Please look forward to it!
Best regards,
Icesitruuna

Official Version Progress Report, 0.8.05 Update Patch, GOG Version Release

We have completed 80% of the remaining resources for the official version and plan to finish the production of most assets by the end of March. After that, we will conduct comprehensive configuration and testing on these assets. The content update for the official version is roughly equivalent to about half of the current version, including 9 BOSS battles and a large amount of level content. Due to its large scale, it will still require a few more months.

We are a very, very small team, with each member carrying crucial responsibilities. The resignation of our partner has led to a lack of some content. To ensure the completeness of the version content, the producer (myself) has temporarily set aside other tasks, fully committed to producing this part of the content, aiming to complete and release the 0.8 version update as soon as possible.

In the meantime, we have also found an experienced veteran with nearly 20 years of industry experience to fill his position. The entire team is filled with confidence and believes that we will be back on track shortly.

We are deeply aware that this delay may bring significant disappointment to players who have been looking forward to this, and we sincerely apologize for this. We promise that we will accelerate our work progress and present our latest achievements to you as soon as possible. Also, we will report our development progress and the latest news to you through the STEAM store community at the earliest time.
If you have any questions or suggestions, we warmly welcome you to contact us at any time, and we will respond as soon as possible.
Once again, thank you for your understanding, trust, and support. We look forward to bringing you a more perfect and captivating gaming experience in the near future!
Best regards,
Icesitruuna

We apologize for the deviation in estimating the amount of additional work, which resulted in insufficient time for testing and optimization after completing the content production. In order to make the new additions more stable, we would like to have more time for testing and optimization. Therefore, the final release date for version 0.6 has been changed to 10:00 AM UTC on June 2nd, 2023. In addition to the content mentioned in the previous announcement (with the key updates being two large maps), here are some new content hints:
1.The costume pack for this time will have a Japanese Miko theme.
How do you feel about combining Miko attire with naginata?
2.Players will learn the movement skill "Phantom Dash," which allows them to penetrate through enemies and appear behind them.
3.A new, more agile action of swiftly climbing up the edges of platforms has been added.
The following is the content mentioned in the previous announcement for your reference：
1> The number of BOSS battles has been increased from the original plan of 2 to 3. All 3 new BOSS battles will be included in the "BOSS Challenge Room".

2> The size of the map has been increased by 20% more than originally planned. Players who have already achieved 100% exploration in the current version will see their exploration rate reduced to around 70% after the update.
3> Two new types of small monsters have been added, beyond the original plan.

4> A new scene rendering technology has been added, which can improve the details of dark areas. However, due to progress in development, it will only be applied to the newly added level scenes temporarily.
5> A new equipment loadout feature has been added, allowing players to save up to 3 different loadout configurations.
6> Guided prompts have been added to the world map, providing players with hints on what they need to do at their current stage.

7> A teleportation stone function has been added, allowing players to obtain teleportation stones in the later stages of the game. Using the stones, players can teleport back to the base and also return to the location where the teleportation stone was used.
8> Several new music tracks have been added, which will be included in the current music DLC.
9> Costume Pack 3 is currently in production, and in addition to including the "Princess Dress" from the previous event, there will be more new outfits available.
Kind,
Icesitruuna

Update plan for the coming period, 0.52.003 update list
In order to make the map and level content updates more continuous and complete, we may use 2-3 big level updates to finish the main plot part of this work.
The following is the tentative plan.
The current level of completeness is 50%.
With the 2nd major update, the game will be 65% complete
The 3rd major update, the game will be 80% complete
The 4th major update will bring the game to 100% completeness, followed by a full release.
We can't be sure of the exact timing of each major update for now, but basically there will be a few months between each one.
In between major updates, we will continue to improve the game's small details, fix bugs, and launch costume DLC at each discount.
After the official version, we will continue to update part of the branch elements, hidden bosses, etc. If the game's popularity can be higher in the future (the number of reviews exceeds 3000+), we
will allocate more manpower to add more new content.

notes.title: Receive the "Heroine's Pajamas" event for free

items.text: The limited time of this event is 24 hours, between 8 am on January 21st to 8 am on January 22nd UTC time, update the game to version 0.52.001, enter the game, and then enter the "Erza's bedroom" in the picture below "You can find a new treasure chest, and then open it to get "Erza's pajamas", and then save it once, and you will get this set of clothes permanently in this save.
After the time expires, the treasure chest will disappear.
Players who missed it for various reasons don’t have to worry too much. This set of pajamas will be integrated into the “Second Season Fashion Pack” in the future, and you can get it when you buy it.
We will update version 0.52.001 at 4:00 pm on January 21st, Beijing time, and will update the "BOSS Challenge Room-Soul Realm". Players can click here
Challenge some bosses that appeared in the past plots. Each BOSS has 5 levels of difficulty to challenge, and the BOSS will have new moves and performances.

notes.title: The location of the room is shown on the map

items.text: This mode requires players to have a high degree of operational proficiency, and to develop the character to a higher level, with powerful equipment and inlaid appropriate magic cores to pass. It is recommended for players who like challenges to try.
Kind,

The "Boss Challenge Room" is working well and we will update this feature on January 20. After killing the big-faced boss in the main storyline, you can walk to the room deeper in the map, and soon you will find a special room, which is the "Field of Souls", where 8 bosses' tombstones are placed, and you will be able to challenge 8 bosses in the main storyline. Players will be transported to a mysterious fighting arena to fight, there will be 5 levels of difficulty for players to challenge, each level of difficulty will have corresponding changes to the bosses, including new moves, faster AI, immunity to abnormal states, stronger attribute values, limit the number of players on the field of characters and so on. After a successful challenge at different levels of difficulty, you will also receive different rewards.
